scope: In-process servers on 127.0.0.1 and a labelled STAND-IN of llama.cpp's server (apps/server/src/assistant/local/standIn.ts) answering scripted JSON; headless Chromium for L13. NO MODEL RAN: every check is about the editor's own behaviour (loopback only, grammar first, grounding, no money, privacy at rest, honest states). Not proven here: a real llama-server, the quality of any model's Hebrew, its speed, a screen reader. Timings are one sample on a shared machine.

with the adapter's connect check fed a socket whose remote address is 10.0.0.5 the job fails local_not_loopback and the stand-in received zero request bodies
a request whose text the grammar reads («חתוך כאן») answers 409 grammar_understood, creates no job row and the stand-in receives nothing

«המוזיקה חזקה מדי, תורידי אותה בשש דציבל» with the stand-in answering gain_change {target music, dir down, db "6"} succeeds with phrase «הנמך את המוזיקה ב־6 דציבל», stages in the order sending, awaiting-local-model, checking, no budget_ledger row, and lane.busy().holder null afterwards

every body the stand-in received holds no Authorization header, no cookie, no owner or agent token, and none of a planted track name, clip id or person name of the project

answers that are not JSON, of the wrong shape, with an intent outside the vocabulary, or whose phrase the grammar cannot read each fail invalid_model_output with their category, and a planted word of the answer is absent from the job row
